scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @blueprint/shared" "npm run dev -w @blueprint/api" "npm run dev -w @blueprint/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @blueprint/shared && npm run dev -w @blueprint/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @blueprint/shared && npm run dev -w @blueprint/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @blueprint/shared && npm run build -w @blueprint/api && npm run build -w @blueprint/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @blueprint/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @blueprint/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @blueprint/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @blueprint/shared && npm run db:seed -w @blueprint/api
